detail.longDescription: Part 2 of 3, How to Train Your Own AI: evaluation. My model scored 94.3 percent on 105 fresh cases, but always answering F2 scored 81.0 and a one-line rule 90.5. On 108 varied cases graded blind by GPT and Claude Opus (they agree about 56 percent of the time) it scored 31.5. The checklist works on any accuracy number. https:// youtu.be/zc7o7v4yRU0 Before trusting a score, what do you check first: the baseline or the error bar? # AI # LLM # MachineLearning # Evaluation
